title: Merge preconditions
statement: Let $L$ and $R$ be lists of integers, let $[?]$ be a memory map from natural-number addresses to integers, and let $a,b,d$ be natural-number addresses. Suppose the memory-space limit is at most the word-size limit, $L$ and $R$ occupy memory segments beginning at $a$ and $b$, respectively, and the regions beginning at $a$, $b$, and $d$ have lengths $|L|$, $|R|$, and $|L|+|R|$, respectively, all ending within the space limit. Suppose also that each input region is apart from the destination region.
hypotheses_covered: space limit is at most word-size limit
left list is a segment of memory at its start address
right list is a segment of memory at its start address
left input region ends within space limit
right input region ends within space limit
destination region ends within space limit
left region is apart from destination region
right region is apart from destination region
